sources.title: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 model card
sources.evidence: Exact Instruct-2507 card reports 30.5B total, 3.3B activated, 262144 native context, non-thinking operation, multilingual instruction following, coding and tool use.

sources.title: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM; qwen3_moe; 48 layers, 128 experts and 8 experts per token; max_position_embeddings 262144.

sources.title: Official checkpoint files
sources.evidence: Public repository includes 16 safetensors shards, tokenizer, configuration and index.

sources.title: Checkpoint Apache license
sources.evidence: Apache License Version 2.0; copyright 2025 Alibaba Cloud.

sources.title: Qwen3 official repository and release news
sources.evidence: Identifies Alibaba Cloud as developer and Qwen3-2507 family. News explicitly dates the exact Instruct release 2025-07-30, conflicting with earlier repository activity and contemporary use.

sources.title: Official checkpoint commit history
sources.evidence: Repository initialization and weight upload occurred July 28, 2025; model-card and license updates followed July 29. Commit dates do not establish when the repository became public.

sources.title: Contemporary Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 usage report
sources.evidence: July 29, 2025 post describes testing this exact model and links the official announcement. Used only to flag the release-date discrepancy, not technical verification.

sources.title: Official launch announcement linked by contemporary report
sources.evidence: Direct retrieval returned 403; announcement contents and timestamp were not independently read.

sources.title: Models.dev baseline record
sources.evidence: Explicitly derives July 28 release_date from Hugging Face repository creation, which is not proof of public release.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud official model release log
sources.evidence: Parent review directly read the release table: exact qwen3-30b-a3b-instruct-2507 listed July 29, 2025 for Beijing, International and Global. This confirms availability one day before the GitHub news entry.

name.note: Display formatting of the official checkpoint identifier.

release_date.note: Earliest explicitly documented public availability is July 29 in the developer release table, consistent with contemporary use. Repository creation is July 28; GitHub news is July 30.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported rounded billion total, including embeddings; model-name 30B is nominal.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-reported rounded billion activated; 8 of 128 experts selected per token.

architecture.note: Configuration explicitly specifies Qwen3 MoE causal language modeling.

context_window.note: Native configuration. Optional 1M extension requires a different supplied configuration.

modalities.note: Tokenizer-based causal text generation; no multimodal encoder in this configuration.

reasoning.note: Non-thinking-only variant; this flag concerns a dedicated thinking mode.

tool_call.note: Agentic section documents tool calling with Qwen-Agent.

description.value: Updated compact Qwen3 MoE instruct model for multilingual chat, coding, and tool use
description.note: Capabilities are supported; compact is a relative descriptor.

patch.notes: Developer-reported counts are 30.5B total and 3.3B active. July 29 availability is explicit in the Alibaba release table; GitHub news followed July 30. Native context is 262144; 1M requires optional extension configuration.

summary: Primary counts corrected to 30.5B total and 3.3B active. Parent follow-up resolved the release date to July 29 using the official release table; native context and all other fields verified.
